review.method: swiftui-pro skill: api, views, data, navigation, design, accessibility, performance, swift, hygiene

totals.detail: 57 individual findings + 8 cross-cutting sweeps; test coverage tracked separately

findings.summary: Force-unwrapped URL built from a free-text tracking reference traps when the value contains a space.
findings.fix: Percent-encode with .urlFragmentAllowed and bind with if let before calling openURL.

findings.summary: save(context:) discards its parameter and saves container.viewContext; 20 call sites pass a context that is ignored.
findings.fix: Save the passed context, mark @MainActor, drop the DispatchQueue.main.async.
findings.outcome: fixed — 87a3c02 (passed context now saved; main-queue deferral deliberately retained)

findings.summary: persistentStoreDescriptions.first!.url! on the launch migration path.
findings.fix: guard let sourceURL = ... else { log; return }.

findings.summary: enumerateContacts runs on DispatchQueue.global and its closure reads self.wrappedName and self.id — Core Data property access off the owning queue.
findings.fix: Snapshot name and id first, run enumeration in Task.detached, hop to MainActor to write; add UserDefaults.setContactID(forID:to:).

findings.summary: syncWithContact() is synchronous and called from .task (MainActor); unifiedContact(withIdentifier:) is a blocking XPC call.
findings.fix: Make it async; call site is Views/PenPalView.swift:261.

findings.summary: displayImage is an async getter with no suspension point, so UIImage decoding runs on the caller's actor (always main).
findings.fix: Wrap the decode in Task.detached and await it.

findings.summary: @AppStorage inside an ObservableObject does not drive view updates; didSet fires after the change and external writes never fire it.
findings.fix: Delete the class; use @AppStorage directly per view. Also removes unused @EnvironmentObject in PenPalList.swift:14 and SettingsList.swift:33.
findings.outcome: fixed — 19328a9 (class deleted; it was never injected or read)

findings.summary: static var shared is a mutable global; same for PersistenceController.preview.
confirmationDialog is inside the ForEach, so N pen pals attach N dialogs to one shared $showDeleteAlert.
findings.fix: Move outside the loop; drive presentation from currentPenPal != nil.

findings.summary: DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(0.05) before delete — a timing guess working around the dialog placement.
findings.fix: Remove once the dialog is moved; otherwise Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(50)).

findings.summary: .animation(.default, value: penpal) never fires — NSManagedObject == is identity comparison. Also EventCell.swift:202.
65-line initializer building predicates and reading UserDefaults; one instance per EventType.orderedCases on every render.
findings.fix: Hoist to static pure functions following the existing sortDescriptors(for:) pattern at line 27.

findings.summary: .task inherits @MainActor so every Core Data fetch blocks the UI; the DispatchQueue.main.async wrappers inside only add latency. 30+ sites app-wide.
findings.fix: Task.detached + newBackgroundContext + performAndWait, assign directly. Recipient blocks at 314-336 must return NSManagedObjectID, not [PenPal].

findings.summary: .font(.system(size: 40, design: .rounded)) pins the three headline figures regardless of Dynamic Type. Also lines 135, 150, 156.
Manual English pluralisation. Also lines 220, 231.
findings.outcome: partially fixed, confirmed on device — 0ed33f8, b2b91a7, c5470ea, 24da3e2 on async-contact-sync (unmerged): line 148 (averageTimeToReply) took four attempts, three bugs caught on device rather than in the diff. 0ed33f8 interpolated roundToDecimalPlaces(1)'s return value, which is a String — inflect can't read a plural category off a String, so it silently fell back to singular ("894 day"). b2b91a7 switched to interpolating the Double directly with specifier: "%.1f", which fixed the pluralisation but always renders one decimal digit, so a whole-number average showed as "894.0 days". c5470ea replaced the specifier with format: .number.precision(.fractionLength(0...1)) to drop the trailing zero, but that broke pluralisation again — the inflector reads specifier:-based interpolation as a raw numeric argument but a format:-based one as an opaque formatted string, same failure mode as the first bug. 24da3e2 restored specifier:, chosen at runtime ("%.0f" vs "%.1f" depending on whether the value is whole) — confirmed correct on device for singular, a whole number, and a fractional one. Lines 220/231 (mostCommonRecipientCount/mostProlificPenPalCount) are passed into PenPalListItem's subText: String, which reaches Text(subText) via a variable, not a literal — inflect markup does not survive that hop and would render as literal "^[...]" text. Left as manual pluralisation; would need subText retyped to LocalizedStringKey or AttributedString to fix properly.

findings.summary: UserDefaults.shared.trackPostingLetters read directly in body — not observable. Also lines 121, 296.
findings.outcome: fixed — 19328a9 (folded in; .task now keyed on StatsQuery)

findings.fix: Extract to YearPill and MostUsedStationeryRow structs, one per file.

findings.fix: Extend the existing Route enum and withAppRouter().

findings.summary: Full if #available(iOS 26) duplicating the entire Button produces _ConditionalContent and differing structural identity.
findings.fix: Extend Backport/Backport.swift with a button-style case, as already done for glassEffect.

findings.summary: Manual pluralisation in dateDivider; also gets zero wrong in English.
findings.outcome: fixed — 0ed33f8 on async-contact-sync (unmerged). difference is an Int interpolated directly, so this one didn't hit the String-argument bug found in the StatsView sibling fix (see statsview-pluralisation) — worth confirming on device anyway since that's exactly how the StatsView regression was caught.

findings.summary: buttonHeight written but never read; three GeometryReaders feed a preference key nothing consumes.
findings.fix: Delete state, modifier, preference key and all three readers.

findings.summary: headerAndButtons() is ~90 lines; also eventTypeMenu and dateDivider(for:).
DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter debug hook keyed on a hard-coded name (inside #if DEBUG).
findings.fix: Task.sleep(for:) so it cancels with the view.

findings.summary: event.allPhotos() called four times per render inside a LazyVStack row. Lines 97, 99, 101, 104.
Photo thumbnail buttons have an Image-only label — nothing for VoiceOver.
iconWidth and IconWidthPreferenceKey declared and never used. Lines 21, 249-255.
CMMotionManager is a stored property on a View struct (re-allocated per re-creation) and 10 Hz updates are never stopped.
findings.fix: @State private var motionManager; AsyncStream; defer { stopDeviceMotionUpdates() }.

findings.summary: @Environment(\.presentationMode) deprecated. Also EventPropertyDetailsSheet.swift:44.
Force-unwrapped literal URLs in the view body. Lines 218, 240.
findings.fix: Hoist to named constants in AppInfo.swift and guard at the use site.

findings.summary: .foregroundColor() faking a disabled look on rows that already have .disabled(). Lines 105, 113, 125.
findings.fix: Remove the modifier; .disabled() draws the correct treatment.

findings.summary: SafariView is a second type declared in this file.
Task { } wrapping synchronous notification-scheduling calls; buys an actor hop and nothing else.
findings.fix: Call directly, or make the underlying functions async if the goal is off-main fetching.

findings.summary: asyncAfter(0.1) resets thingsHaveChanged after the .task fires eight onChange handlers; on a slow launch the flag stays true and blocks swipe-to-dismiss.
findings.outcome: fixed — 82583a2 on main, differently to the proposed fix. A guard flag reset via a synchronous defer right after the assignments doesn't actually close the race: nothing yields between the assignments and the defer, so onChange callbacks fire on a later run-loop turn, after the guard is already back to false — same failure mode, just without the arbitrary delay. Went with a derived comparison instead: thingsHaveChanged is now (trackedFields != initialFields), with initialFields snapshotted once population finishes. No ordering dependency on when onChange fires, so no race is possible. Also resolves addevent-repeated-onchange, below — the seven onChange handlers that existed solely to set the flag were deleted; letterType's stays for its defaultIgnore side effect.

findings.summary: User-input filtering with lowercased().contains(). Also SymbolPicker.swift:29.
Ellipsis suggestion button is an Image in a Button with no text label.
250-line body; save action at 633-639 is a ~200-char 14-argument expression duplicated across create/update.
findings.fix: Extract a save() method and an EventDraft value type; split the photo, stationery and toggle sections into views.

findings.summary: Eight near-identical onChange handlers all setting thingsHaveChanged = true.
findings.fix: Compose tracked fields into one Equatable value and watch that.
findings.outcome: fixed — 82583a2 on main, as a side effect of addevent-asyncafter-race above. thingsHaveChanged is now derived from a TrackedFields Equatable snapshot rather than set imperatively, so the seven handlers that existed only to flip the flag are gone entirely.

findings.summary: Four types in one file: CustomStationeryTypeView, StationeryTypeView, AddStationeryTypeForm, AddEventSheet.
updateStationery() runs three fetchDistinctStationery calls on the main actor, from both .task and onChange(of: eventType). Also cornerRadius(10) at line 490.
@Binding used for values the child never writes. Also SentAndWrittenByDayOfWeekChart.swift:39-40 and SentAndWrittenByMonthChart.swift.
Chart data computed only in onChange(of: events); renders permanently empty if the view mounts with events already populated. Works today only by ordering coincidence.
findings.fix: Derive chartData from the input rather than caching in @State.

findings.summary: parsedData filters and sorts in body and is called twice; .frame(height: count * 50) also ignores Dynamic Type.
findings.fix: Filter and sort once at fetch time; use @ScaledMetric for row height.

findings.summary: .filter { }.count allocates an intermediate array. Also SentAndWrittenByMonthChart.swift:73.
SENT_AND_WRITTEN_BY_DAY_OF_WEEK_DATA ships in the release binary and is referenced nowhere; MostUsedStationeryChart.swift:19-34 carries 15 lines of commented-out placeholders.
ParameterCount.id is a fresh UUID() per construction, so every Core Data refetch hands ForEach entirely new identities — rows are destroyed and recreated. Identifiable and Equatable also disagree.
presentationMode and .navigationBarLeading. Lines 44, 349, 394, 419.
applicationIconBadgeNumber deprecated in iOS 17.
infoDictionary?["CFBundleName"] as! String force-casts Any? and traps on nil. Lines 13, 21, 25.
alert(isPresented:) { Alert(...) } is the iOS 13 API; the lone dismiss button can be omitted entirely.
findings.outcome: fixed — aa1d493 on async-contact-sync (unmerged). Correction: the review's proposed fix (an empty actions closure, falling back to the system default OK button) would have silently dropped the custom "🧡" dismiss button. The actual commit kept it: actions: { Button("🧡") { } }, not actions: { }.

findings.summary: Text concatenation with + — deprecated and breaks localisation by splitting the sentence.
findings.fix: Interpolate the styled Text into a single string.

findings.summary: Remaining force unwraps: DebugView.swift:45 (debug-only), TipJarView.swift:31, Data/Export.swift:228.
Router publishes at object granularity, so a presentedSheet change invalidates everything watching path.
Combine sink captures self strongly and mutates @Published on an arbitrary queue. SyncMonitor.swift:35 has the same shape plus a dead if #available(iOS 14.0, *) at line 44.
Fourth ObservableObject. Its urls getter calls item.temporaryURL() per image on every access, writing files to disk from a property QLPreviewCoordinator reads per item.
findings.fix: Migrate to @Observable and cache the URLs.

findings.summary: 58 foregroundColor(_:) call sites across 21 files.
23 one-parameter onChange call sites across 9 files.
18 PreviewProvider structs.
13 .navigationBarLeading/.navigationBarTrailing placements. PenPalTab.swift:46 and PenPalView.swift:234 already use the modern spelling — drift, not style.
3 cornerRadius(_:) call sites: SymbolPicker.swift:44, AddEventSheet.swift:490, EventCell.swift:44.
4 ScrollView(showsIndicators: false): StatsView:91, AddEventSheet:85 and :481, EventCell:103.
3 Color(uiColor: UIColor.x): AppInfo.swift:21, SettingsList.swift:19, AddEventSheet.swift:97.
30+ DispatchQueue.main.async wrappers inside .task closures that already run on the MainActor.
findings.fix: Assign directly; move the real work off-main with a background context.

findings.summary: No test target. EventType.nextLogicalEventTypes/groupingEventType (~24 cases across 9 types x 2 trackPostingLetters modes), PenPal.averageTimeToRespond (~8), Calendar.numberOfDaysBetween (~6) are pure logic worth covering.
findings.fix: Add a Swift Testing target covering the three above.
